explanation_chain: Wildfire, satellite/archive-only mode: no in-situ fire-weather station or provincial assessment was used.
NBAC loaded: 0 perimeter-years in window, 53-yr record.
Burn history: 0 NBAC perimeter-years over a 53-year record; the mean annual fraction of burnable land burned in this window is 0.0165% (CI 0.0000%-6.7584%) — the regional base rate.
Local exposure: this address is 0 m from continuous wildland fuel (exposure e-fold 500 m) on 2 deg terrain (slope multiplier up to 1+0.5).

Annual burn probability = 1 - exp(-rate x exposure x slope), updated per-pixel by observed burned-year counts (Beta-Binomial; pixel trials deflated 5x for correlation with the regional rate, which the same years estimated).
The graded number is REACH probability: the maximum within 250 m of the address (0.01%, vs 0.01% at the exact pixel) — a fire at the fence line is the risk to the structure.
Reach-back: no mapped historical burn intersects this window.

Regional-rate floor applied: the 40 km burn history implies a base rate of 0.0165%, above the 0.0000% measured inside the 3 km map window; the higher, region-supported rate is used so this number cannot contradict the history below (B2).
Model constants: fire defaults v0.22 (wui_decay=500.0 m, slope_boost=0.5, c=1.0, prior_w=8)

Regional fire history (40 km window): Past 10 years: 5 mapped fires (NBAC >=200 ha) (years: 2025, 2024, 2023, 2022, 2018); nearest 6.3 km (2025). Past 20 years: 10 mapped fires (NBAC >=200 ha) (years: 2025, 2024, 2023, 2022, 2018, 2012, ...); nearest 4.4 km (2009). Past 50 years: 22 mapped fires (NBAC >=200 ha) (years: 2025, 2024, 2023, 2022, 2018, 2012, ...); nearest 4.4 km (2009).
mandatory_caveats: Archive-only: grade capped at C. NBAC maps burns >~ 200 ha reliably; small/urban-interface fires are under-represented, so the central value is a lower bound of this evidence channel.
No fire-weather forecast is included: this is climatological frequency, not current-season danger (CWFIS FWI is the M-FIRE-2 addition).
The exposure/slope form is an interim disclosed model; it is replaced, not tuned (Lever 3).
